comment: 22yo male, asymptomatic, recently confirmed germline CEBPA pathogenic variant (c.68dupC, N-terminal frameshift) on buccal-swab germline panel ordered after his 26yo brother was diagnosed with AML and a biallelic CEBPA (germline N-terminal + acquired bZIP indel) clone was identified on the tumor's myeloid NGS. Father deceased of AML at 35 (now retrospectively presumed CEBPA-driven). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = CEBPA carrier surveillance — CBC + smear q3-6mo lifelong, BMA + myeloid NGS at any suspicious change, buccal-confirmed cascade testing for sister (age 18) + maternal-side relatives, mandatory germline screening of any candidate sibling donor; alternative = intensified track with q3-month CBC, scheduled BMA every 2-3 years from age 20, pre-emptive HLA-typing of his sister + first-cousins, pre-emptive consultation with the hereditary-myeloid program at a tertiary center.
